guitar.modelsText: Gibson SG / Fender Telecaster / Gibson Les Paul
guitar.notes: Confirmed — Louis Bertignac is well known in French rock for SG and Telecaster usage; medium confidence appropriate given two guitarists and varied gear.

tone.target: bright punky new-wave crunch with wiry attack
tone.profile: bright punky new-wave crunch with wiry attack
tone.summary: A compressed signal through a Vox-style preamp (AC30 TB) combined with a small cab simulation, utilizing light overdrive for bite and a touch of room ambience for space without wash.
corrections: French new-wave punk not ambient texture

blocks.purpose: Clean up signal and maintain tight rhythmic definition.
Provide tight rhythmic drive and punchy attack required for new wave punk.
Achieve light breakup crunch and bright biting upper mids without heavy saturation.
No heavy distortion needed; the Green OD and Comp provide sufficient grit.
Simulate the bright, punchy Vox/Marshall edge-of-breakup sound.
Focus the tone into a small-room, punchy British cabinet sound.
Enhance the bright biting upper mids and overall punchiness.
Avoid chorus haze as per instructions.
Provide minimal slapback delay for subtle space without ambient wash.
Add a touch of raw small-room edge and natural space.

improvements.summary: Replace the current cabinet IR with a smaller, more focused model to enhance the raw, punchy small-room edge required for new wave punk.

proposals.reason: The current 4x12 is too large; a smaller combo IR will enhance the raw, punchy small-room edge.
proposals.expectedGain: Tighter, more focused low end and increased bite.
